cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a mixed, rotational tape, 54% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -1.82% · WTI -1.59% · Brent -5.00% · NatGas +0.86%. At the last close, 54% of 67 energy names were green — a mixed, rotational tape. Refining & Downstream did the heavy lifting at +3.32%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +3.32%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -4.60%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at -8.61%
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
